class.name: ColorRect
class.brief_description: A control that displays a solid color rectangle.
class.description: Displays a rectangle filled with a solid [member color]. If you need to display the border alone, consider using a [Panel] instead.

members.member: The fill color of the rectangle.
The semantic role used to resolve the fill color from [member color_scheme]. If set to [constant @GlobalScope.COLOR_ROLE_STATIC], [member color] is used unchanged.
The color scheme used to resolve [member color_role]. If unset, the control's inherited default color scheme is used.
